name: SHQ1, H/ACA ribonucleoprotein assembly factor

function.text: SHQ1 encodes protein SHQ1 homolog. It participates in protein-RNA complex assembly and box H/ACA snoRNP assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder with dystonia and seizures (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
